summary.business_type: Local Service (hybrid — fixed kitchen + partner agriturismo venues, brick-and-mortar-adjacent)
top_findings: No claimed Google Business Profile and zero reviews anywhere — Local SEO scores 26/100 for this reason alone

Published NAP address ("Via dei Pastai 12") contradicts landing-page copy that says the real meeting point is sent only after booking, and the agriturismo page reveals the meeting point actually varies by partner estate — this may require a Service-Area Business GBP listing, not a storefront pin
Google Search Console API access is now fully broken (invalid_grant — service account itself appears revoked/deleted), not just misconfigured — no live GSC data could be pulled this pass
LCP (2.52s mobile, borderline) is caused by the hero H1 being hidden by a scroll-reveal fade animation even though it's above the fold — a cheap, high-impact fix
Article schema has a real code bug: non-English blog posts' Article.publisher @id points to a locale-prefixed node that doesn't exist on the page (dangling reference)
"Team building" content is served by exactly one page despite being a major demand cluster; the top local competitor runs 7+ spoke pages for the same intent

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Mobile hamburger nav confirmed fixed and functional (was Critical/broken in the 2026-08-08 audit)
Sitemap hreflang gap fully resolved — all 155 URLs carry correct en/it/fr/de/zh + x-default alternates
robots.txt well-scoped with explicit AI-crawler allowlist
Strong security headers (HSTS preload, tight CSP, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy)
Single-hop 301s for http→https and www→apex; canonicals self-reference correctly

findings.title: Published NAP address contradicts booking-flow copy
findings.description: Footer.astro and Schema.astro's LocalBusiness JSON-LD publish "Via dei Pastai 12" as a fixed street address sitewide, while src/data/landings.ts (line ~193) and the FAQ tell visitors the exact address is sent only after booking. The agriturismo landing page further reveals the meeting point varies by which partner estate is used for a given class — meaning the business may not have one fixed storefront address at all.
findings.recommendation: Resolve before any GBP/citation submission: confirm whether this is a fixed kitchen (use the real address consistently) or a variable meeting point across partner venues (switch the GBP category to Service-Area Business and remove the fixed streetAddress from schema/footer).

findings.title: Google Search Console API access broken (invalid_grant)
findings.description: Every live GSC call (sites, search analytics, sitemaps, URL inspection) failed with invalid_grant: Invalid grant: account not found for the service account gsc-mcp-server@project-6317742d-5528-4d87-b86.iam.gserviceaccount.com. This is a hard OAuth failure, not a permissions issue. Separately, ~/.config/claude-seo/google-api.json has default_property pointed at an unrelated site (lakebovilla.com).
findings.recommendation: Regenerate/re-verify the service account key (or confirm the GCP project still exists), re-grant Search Console access to handmadepastaflorence.com, and fix default_property. Until this is fixed, all SEO measurement is manual export only.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Story section now names both chefs with specific, credible bios (was anonymous in the prior audit)
AI-citation readiness is strong on facts: llms.txt, FAQPage/Article/Product JSON-LD, direct-answer blog ledes
Locale translations spot-checked (DE) are genuine, not machine-duplicated

findings.title: FAQ still lacks policy answers
findings.description: All 10 FAQ entries remain purely factual (location, duration, group size). The component's own code comment confirms cancellation/deposit/meeting-point/kids-age answers are still pending owner sign-off.
findings.recommendation: Get the missing policy answers from the business owner and add them — this also unblocks the SXO-flagged "no visible cancellation policy" competitive gap.

findings.title: Story section still uses generic stock photos, not real photos of the named chefs
findings.description: Endri and Marsel are now named with real bios, but the section still uses stock images (cutting-pizza.webp, a reused hero photo) rather than real photos. Marsel also has no surname or schema sameAs, asymmetric with Endri's fuller profile.
findings.recommendation: Add real photos of both chefs; give Marsel the same schema/bio depth as Endri.

findings.title: Reviews remain empty
findings.description: src/data/reviews.ts is still an empty array. The Reviews component and AggregateRating schema are correctly wired to activate automatically once real reviews are added, and the code correctly refuses to fabricate them.
findings.recommendation: Start the post-class review-request habit (WhatsApp/email link) — this is the single highest-leverage content/trust fix and also unblocks Local SEO and Schema improvements.

findings.title: 12 of 13 blog posts fall below the 1,500-word content-depth guideline
findings.description: The one sampled post that does meet depth is well-structured; the shortfall isn't uniformly a thin-content risk but is worth tracking as the blog scales.
findings.recommendation: No urgent action; keep in mind for future posts, especially ones competing on informational queries.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tags and meta descriptions are strong on the pages checked (home, pasta-making-class-florence): descriptive, keyword-forward, and state price/duration
Single H1 per page, healthy H2 count (11 on homepage)

Dedicated one-keyword-one-page landing architecture (from the 2026-07-27 pass) gives deep, non-cannibalized internal linking — independently praised by the SXO agent as a genuine local-organic strength

findings.title: No freshness signal (lastmod / updatedDate) surfaced on content pages
findings.description: Neither the sitemap nor blog post pages currently expose a maintained last-modified date.
findings.recommendation: Source lastmod from blog frontmatter dates and a maintained field for landing/shape pages (see Sitemap category).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Shared JSON-LD builders (faqSchema, breadcrumbSchema) are clean and reused correctly
No fabricated reviews, no deprecated schema types
Product/Offer schema correctly localized on the homepage (a prior bug there was already fixed)
AggregateRating/Review correctly withheld until real reviews exist, with plumbing already wired to auto-populate the moment they are

findings.title: Article.publisher @id is a dangling reference on every non-English blog post
findings.description: BlogPostPage.astro builds Article.publisher's @id using the page's own locale prefix (e.g. .../de/#business), but Schema.astro's sitewide LocalBusiness node always uses the locale-invariant .../#business. Confirmed live on the German "best flour" post. ShapePage.astro already does this correctly (hardcoded, no prefix).
findings.recommendation: In BlogPostPage.astro, hardcode the publisher @id the same way ShapePage.astro does (no locale prefix) — one-line fix.

findings.title: LocalBusiness still lacks geo coordinates and business-level sameAs
findings.description: Unchanged since the 2026-08-08 audit; legitimately blocked on owner-provided data (Google Maps coordinates, real social/GBP URLs), not a code defect.
findings.recommendation: Add once GBP is claimed and coordinates are known.

findings.title: LocalBusiness node missing logo; no VideoObject markup
findings.description: Minor structured-data completeness gaps.
findings.recommendation: Add logo when a real logo asset exists (see R14 in REMAINING-SEO-TASKS.md); consider VideoObject if/when video content is produced.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: TTFB is excellent (38-40ms) — does NOT share the sister site's CDN/TTFB problem
CLS is effectively zero (0.000-0.004), confirming the prior width/height fix holds
No third-party scripts at all

findings.title: LCP element is hidden behind a scroll-reveal animation applied even above the fold
findings.description: Mobile LCP is 2.52s (borderline "Needs Improvement"). The LCP element is the hero H1 text, which is opacity:0 and revealed via IntersectionObserver + a 0.9s transition with per-element delays up to 440ms (src/components/Hero.astro, src/layouts/Layout.astro, src/styles/global.css). This render delay accounts for 72-95% of LCP.
findings.recommendation: Exempt above-the-fold hero text from the [data-reveal] pattern, or make its reveal delay ~0 so it doesn't gate LCP.

findings.title: 248KB of oversized/uncompressed non-hero gallery images
findings.description: Story/Experiences section images were not covered by the prior hero-image optimization pass.
findings.recommendation: Compress and convert remaining gallery images the same way the hero-card image was handled.

findings.title: Custom font served as raw TTF instead of WOFF2
findings.description: GoldenHills.ttf is served uncompressed.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WOFF2 for smaller transfer size.

findings.title: Elevated mobile TBT proxy (320ms) from forced synchronous reflow
findings.description: Header.astro's script causes a 177ms forced reflow; likely compounded by the hero parallax scroll handler.
findings.recommendation: Profile and defer/batch the layout-triggering script work in Header.astro.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Pricing (€95/3hrs/max-8) is genuinely citable in raw HTML — title, meta, visible prose, JSON-LD, and llms.txt all agree (verified live, unlike the sister site's pricing gap)
AI crawler access is fully healthy: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended all allowed
llms.txt is live, byte-matches source, and includes the pasta-shapes hub

findings.title: Hero price badge sits outside the boilerplate-stripped main text stream
findings.description: A content extractor (trafilatura) drops the widget block containing the price badge, so price doesn't surface until ~200 words into extracted content on landing pages.
findings.recommendation: Add one price/duration sentence to the opening prose paragraph of each landing page, not just the widget.

findings.title: Zero external brand signals
findings.description: No YouTube, Reddit, Wikipedia, TripAdvisor, or GBP links found anywhere. No VideoObject content. Expected for a ~1-month-old business but is the single highest-leverage unshipped GEO item given YouTube's correlation with AI citation.
findings.recommendation: Longer-term: video content + external profile presence once GBP/marketplace listings exist.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All homepage images use modern formats (webp/png), no legacy jpg
width/height set on all images (CLS confirmed at ~0)
4 homepage icon images have empty alt — likely correct practice for decorative icons paired with adjacent text labels, not a defect

findings.title: 248KB of oversized non-hero gallery images
findings.description: Same finding as under Performance — Story/Experiences section images weren't covered by the prior optimization pass.
findings.recommendation: Compress/convert remaining gallery images.

findings.title: Verify decorative-icon empty alt is intentional
findings.description: 4 "why choose us" icon images (rolling pin, wine, group, Duomo) have alt present but empty. This is correct practice only if adjacent text already conveys the same meaning.
findings.recommendation: Spot-check that each icon has a text label right next to it; if any icon stands alone, give it descriptive alt text instead.

supplementary_categories.name: Local SEO

findings.title: No Google Business Profile, zero reviews, zero Tier-1 citations
findings.description: No Maps embed, no place link, no review widget anywhere on the live site. reviews.ts is empty. No TripAdvisor/GetYourGuide/Airbnb/Yelp presence found (search-engine verification was unreliable this session due to consent walls, so absence is inferred, not fully proven).

findings.description: Unchanged since the prior audit — a citation-conflation risk once either site claims a GBP.

supplementary_categories.name: Backlinks
supplementary_categories.note: Floor estimate — Common Crawl has no record of the domain at all (site launched after CC's latest web-graph release). Not a fault, expected for a 2.5-month-old domain. Not part of the core weighted Health Score.

findings.title: No cheap backlink move available this pass (correction)
findings.description: An earlier draft of this report recommended hyperlinking "Agriturismo Borgo Divino" (named in the Story copy) as a partner backlink opportunity with a reciprocal-link ask. Per the site owner, that's incorrect — it's Endri's own workplace (he's their Head Chef), not a separate business relationship, so there's no partner to ask a favor of. Withdrawn.
findings.recommendation: Realistic near-term backlink sources remain marketplace listings (GetYourGuide/Viator/Airbnb/TripAdvisor) and local press/blogger outreach — see the action plan.

supplementary_categories.name: Content Cluster (Team Building)
supplementary_categories.note: Qualitative gap analysis, not part of the weighted Health Score.

findings.title: Team-building intent served by exactly one page vs. competitor's 7+ spoke pages
findings.description: Verified: src/data/landings.ts has exactly one team-building page per locale, zero supporting blog posts. Top Florence competitor (mamaflorence.com) ranks 7+ distinct spoke URLs around its own team-building hub. Ownership check against the two-sites-keyword-split rule confirms this content correctly belongs on handmadepastaflorence.com, not endricerhozi.com.
findings.recommendation: Build 8 new EN+IT blog spokes across 4 sub-clusters (Activity Format, Group Size/Logistics, Corporate Packages, Seasonal/Occasion), each linking bidirectionally to the existing team-building pillar and relevant money pages. Full spoke list and link matrix are in findings/cluster.md.

supplementary_categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
supplementary_categories.note: SXO Gap Score, not part of the weighted Health Score.

findings.title: No page-type mismatch — the authority gap is real, and sharper than generic
findings.description: SERP-backwards check on 6 English commercial queries found HPF absent from all results, which are dominated by OTA listings and mamaflorence.com using the same Product-page format HPF already builds. The gap: mamaflorence.com embeds AggregateRating (4.88★/600 reviews) directly in Product schema and runs ~3x the word count (3,072 vs 1,143) on a comparable page.
findings.recommendation: Confirms reviews + schema AggregateRating as the top lever (already the #1 finding from Local SEO), plus consider expanding thin commercial-page copy once reviews land.

findings.title: No visible cancellation policy, unlike every ranking OTA competitor
findings.description: Every competing SERP result advertises "Free cancellation" in its title. HPF's booking flow is WhatsApp-chat-only with no visible cancellation policy anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add a clear, visible cancellation/rescheduling policy — this also closes the FAQ policy-answer gap flagged under Content Quality.

supplementary_categories.name: Sitemap
supplementary_categories.note: Structural quality gate, folded into Technical SEO's weight rather than scored separately in the core envelope.

findings.title: lastmod entirely absent from all 155 sitemap URLs
findings.description: 0 of 155 URLs carry a lastmod date — worse than all-identical, since it gives zero freshness signal at all.
findings.recommendation: Source lastmod from blog frontmatter dates and a maintained field for landing/shape pages, not build time.

supplementary_categories.note: Could not be measured this pass — see Technical SEO's invalid_grant finding. All GSC figures cited elsewhere in this report are unverified historical figures from prior manual exports (memory), not refreshed live data.
